select a.ID, a.PCODE, case a.ID when 'dep7004' then substr(a.text, 0, instr(a.text, '_', 1) - 1) else a.text end text, a.PID, a.ATTR, a.TEXTPY, case when a.pcode = 6000000300 then 1 when a.pcode = '6000000303' then 2 when a.pcode = '6000000302' then 3 when a.pcode = '6000000301' then 4 when a.pcode = '6000000305' then 5 when a.pcode = '6000000307' then 6 else 99 end order_by, a.ORD from (select a.*, ord from (select 'dep' || t.depid id, t.depcode pcode, substr(t.location, instr(t.location, '-', 1) + 1, Length(t.location)) text, 'org' || t.compid pid, 'dep' attr, to_char(t.depid) textpy from comm_department t where t.isdisabled = '0' and t.depcode = #{code}
union all select 'dep' || t.depid id, t.depcode pcode, substr(t.location, instr(t.location, '-', 1) + 1, Length(t.location)) text, decode(m.centerid, null, 'dep' || t.adminid, 'cen' || m.centerid) pid, 'dep' attr, to_char(t.depid) textpy from comm_department t left join ppm_da_dept_manager m on t.depid = m.deptid where t.adminid is not null and t.isdisabled = '0' and t.adminid = '7004'
union all select 'gro' || ga.id id, ga.id pcode, ga.groupname text, 'dep' || ga.depid pid, 'gro' attr, to_char(ga.depid) textpy from ppm_da_team_group ga where ga.isdel = '0'
union all select 'cen' || m.id id, to_char(m.id) pcode, m.centername text, 'dep7004' pid, 'cen' attr, to_char(m.id) textpy from Ppm_Da_Center m) a left join ppm_dept_ord o on a.id = o.depid start with a.pcode in (select #{code} from dual) connect by prior a.id = a.pid ) a order by order_by

select a.* from ( select 'org' || t.compid id, t.compcode pcode, t.location text, 'org' || t.adminid pid, 'org' attr, 0 manageid, 0 ranksort, '' textpy, '' empstatus , '' fullname , '' spellname from comm_organization t where t.isdisabled = '0' union select 'dep' || t.depid id, t.depcode pcode, t.location text, 'org' || t.compid pid, 'dep' attr, 0 manageid, 0 ranksort, '' textpy, '' empstatus , '' fullname , '' spellname from comm_department t where t.adminid is null and t.isdisabled = '0' union select 'dep' || t.depid id, t.depcode pcode, t.location text, 'dep' || t.adminid pid, 'dep' attr, 0 manageid, 0 ranksort, '' textpy, '' empstatus, '' fullname , '' spellname from comm_department t where t.adminid is not null and t.isdisabled = '0' union select distinct 'emp' || t.eid id, t.badge pcode, t.empname || '(' || t.badge || ')' text, 'dep' || t.depid pid, 'emp' attr, 1 manageid, nvl(b.ranknum, 0) ranksort, '' textpy, '' empstatus , '' fullname , '' spellname from COMM_PARTTIMEJOB t left join comm_department a on t.depid = a.depid left join ppm_system_userrank b on t.badge = b.userid and t.depid = b.deptno where t.isdisable = 0
and t.badge in (${badge}})
union select 'emp' || t.badge id, t.badge pcode, t.empname || '(' || t.badge || ')' text, 'dep' || t.depid pid, 'emp' attr, case when t.eidhr = a.director then 1 else 0 end manageid, nvl(b.ranknum, 0) ranksort, '' textpy, '' empstatus , t.fullname , t.spellname from ppm_emp_view t left join comm_department a on t.depid = a.depid left join ppm_system_userrank b on t.badge = b.userid and t.depid = b.deptno where t.badge not like 'k%' and t.badge not like 'K%' and t.badge not like 'L%' and t.badge not like 'l%' and t.depid != '7004'
and t.badge in (${badge}})
) a
1=1
AND ( instr(a.pcode,#{userData}) > 0 or instr(a.text, #{userData}) > 0 or instr(a.textpy, #{userData}) > 0 or instr( upper(a.fullname), upper(#{userData})) > 0 or instr(upper(a.spellname), upper(#{userData})) > 0 ) AND
start with a.id = 'dep'||#{deptNo} connect by prior a.id = a.pid AND
start with a.id = 'org'||#{adminId} connect by prior a.id = a.pid AND
order by manageid desc, ranksort desc, pcode asc
